objective: Determine whether the relative utility of broad RFF and structured SAVE+RFF filling changes reproducibly with requested shortlist depth.

methods.unbounded_winner_fill: Preserve the complete broad-RFF winner group and rank every remaining candidate by SAVE+RFF.
methods.bounded_2k: Preserve the complete broad-RFF winner group; retrieve complete broad-RFF groups until at least min(2k,16) candidates are retained; rank the remainder of that pool by SAVE+RFF before all outside candidates.
methods.winner_preserved_pool_oracle: Outcome-using diagnostic ceiling: preserve the complete broad-RFF winner group and rank remaining broad top-2k pool candidates by the best-head envelope.

ties.retrieval_cutoff: Include a complete broad-RFF group crossing depth 2k.
ties.shortlist_cutoff: Uniformly average all top-k subsets admitted by a rank-group tie.

bootstrap.unit: seed panel within equal-weight cohort-by-family stratum
bootstrap.pairing: Every method contrast preserves cohort, seed, and family.

checks: upper95 candidate-minus-broad top5 mean utility regret < 0
point candidate-minus-broad top5 mean utility regret < 0 in each input cohort
all 60 panels and all decision-driving depth metrics complete and finite; oracle capture fraction is explicitly null only when oracle pool headroom is zero
top5_confirmation_justification.pass: Every check must pass. A pass justifies one frozen new-seed top-five confirmation; it does not itself promote a method.

scope: Post-outcome diagnostic reanalysis of two completed synthetic cohorts. No model is refit, no ranking rule is promoted, and any resulting top-five hypothesis requires unused-seed confirmation.
